d:
2025 went by faster than any of us planned. Our annual Yearmix is one of the few times we slow down and look back at everything we made.
This year, we released eight compilations, five mixes, one remix album, one EP, and 14 loose singles. This mix showcases some of our favorites of the year and is a small sampling of our many drops. A seamless listening experience full of music for working, zoning out, staring at your screen, or avoiding your inbox.
